title: RuntimeTargetDescriptor
description: Name reserved by runtime-target-v1, which this corpus does not activate. The canonical shape (architecture section 9.7: ref, node, provider, capabilities, state, lastEventSeq, observedAt/expiresAt; never a provider locator, profile bytes, native handle, or stream secret) is adopted only when both repositories accept runtime-target-v1 schemas and fixtures. Fail-closed until then: no value validates against this reservation.
